segments.text: 26 What beleeueſt thou, when thou ſaieſt, I beleeue in God the Father almightie, maker of heauen and earth?

I beleeue the euerlaſting father of our Lord Ieſus Chriſt who hath made of nothing heauen & earth, with all that are in them, who like-wiſe vpholdeth and gouerneth the ſame by his eternal Counſel and prouidence; to bee my God & my Father for Chriſtes ſake: and therefore I doe ſo truſt in him, and ſo relie on him, that I make no doubt, but he will prouide all things neceſſarie both for my ſoule and bodie. And further whatſoeuer euils he ſendeth on mee in this troubleſome life, hee will turne them to my ſafety, ſeeing both he is able to doe it, as beeing God almightie; and willing to doe it, as beeing a bountifull father.
27 What is the prouidence of God?

The Almighty power of God euery where preſent, whereby hee doth as it were with his hand vphold & gouerne heauen & earth, with all
the creatures therin: So that thoſe thinges which growe in the earth, as likewiſe raine and drouth, fruitfulnes & barrainnes, meat & drink, health and ſikneſſe, riches and pouertie, in a woord, all things come not raſhly or by chance, but by his fatherly counſell and will.
28 What doth this knowledge of the Creation and prouidence of God profite vs?

That in aduerſitie wee may bee patient, and thankfull in proſperitie, & haue hereafter our chiefeſt hope repoſed in God our moſt faithfull father, beeing ſure that there is nothing which may withdrawe vs from his loue, for as much as all creatures are ſo in his power, that without his will they are not able not only to do any thing, but not ſo much as once to moue.
